Name: Shop Tabs
Author: AltoIgloo
Description:
Love mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22490]Bonster's Combined Crops[/url] but get tired of scrolling ~15 years just to reach the saplings? This is your solution to more efficient shopping! Shop Tabs adds a dynamic set of tabs on top of each shop in the game, each filtering the shop's sold items into different catagories.

[size=5]Current supported catagories:[/size]
[list]
[*]Seeds
[*]Saplings
[*]Cooking
[*]Fertillizer
[*]Crops
[*]Recipes
[*]Animal Product
[*]Fish
[*]Artisan
[*]Flowers
[*]Minerals
[*]Crafting
[*]Monster Drops
[*]Bait
[*]Artifacts
[*]Other
[*]All
[/list]
[size=5]Known issues:[/size]
[list]
[*]All non-Object type items in the base game (weapon, tools, etc) are filtered into "Other"
[*]Swapping out of a tab after purchasing a limited-amount item, and immediately swapping back will restock it. (you can solve this by re-opening the shop)
[*]Using Lookup Anything on a shop item will cause all other filters to disappear. (you can solve this by re-opening the shop)
[*]
[*][size=3]------Controller specific issues------[/size]
[*]moving cursor down from a shop tab will cause it to jump to the second sold item tab, rather than the first
[*]in tabs with less than 4 items, purchasing the first item, then move to another shop tab, then move the cursor down will cause the menu to scoll down by one tab for no reason
[*]possible other odd behaviors with navigating the menu
[*]
[*][size=3]------Bugs reported (thanks!) ------[/size]
[*]
[*]Incompatible with Searchable Shops
[*]Tab sprites doesn't update with custom UI interface mods (working)
[*]In some UI scaling, the tabs will look like they're poking through the top of the screen (I'm unsure if it's fixable, will look into it)
[*]Some items in Lumisteria's Serene Meadows and Cornucopia are not being categorized correctly (will look into it)
[/list]
This mod has not been tested for splitscreen multiplayer (should be supported however), multiplayer or all platforms other than Windows and Linux/steamdeck. Any information on the compatibilities with the above would be super welcome!

[size=5]Compatibilities:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]All vinilla shops[/size]
[*][size=2]Any mod that add custom shops using the built in ShopMenu class, e.g:[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url][/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22600]Passerby Cemetry﻿[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Any mod that alters the shop stock should also work[/size]
[*][size=2]If you find anything that is incompatible, leave a comment and I'll be on it[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Config:[/size]
[list]
[*]Currently not configuable but the default categories are already quite extensive. 
[*]Please let me know if you need any additional categories made!
[/list]
[size=5]Translations:[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Via i18n[/size]
[*]default: English

[*][size=2]Translations welcome! For i18n, please create a pull request on Github and it will be merged into the next update. [/size]
[/list]
